ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY001_DESC: It's got all the twiddly knobs, the fancy band and something called a bezel. Treasure it.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY005_DESC: How many kills until I get the nuke? Now you don't have to ask anymore - just look at your watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY006_DESC: A pet watch that lets you hatch and look after your very own monster. It's a game within a game.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY007_DESC: Once you've drawn your last breath, the step counter will act as a memorial... until the battery runs out.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY008_DESC: You HAVE time to kill, or it IS time to kill? Your choice with this functional timepiece which tracks your K/D.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0101_DESC: Sail into darkness with the Black Sea Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0102_DESC: Careful not to drop the Desert Sands Watch on the beach, you may never find it again.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0103_DESC: Time your victory with the Mangrove Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY0104_DESC: There's only one time that matters with the Sublime Watch... Just check your wrist.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY010_DESC: When your back is against the wall - it's time to crunch!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY011_DESC: Stay hungry with the Dinner Time watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY012_DESC: Always be on time with this DIY vacuum fluorescent display - long on brightness, short on battery life!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY013_DESC: Bask in the splendor of the Golden Grandeur watch
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY014_DESC: Strong, reliable, and readable yet impeccably beautiful. Handcrafted to the highest of standards.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY015_DESC: Thank you for participating in the Season 3 drops program!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY016_DESC: Not only does this watch tell perfect time but it keeps track of your progress through the ranks.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY018_DESC: Show off your true colors and your impeccable timekeeping skills, all in one chronographic triumph.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY019_DESC: Analogue precision + soft, glow-in-the-dark hands = the night raid operator's best friend.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY020_DESC:
Thank you for supporting our veterans!
Visit callofdutyendowment.org to learn more
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY021_DESC: Never lose track of the real time or date with the Digital Ink Watch - good for both martial and marital situational awareness.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY022_DESC: This one is for people who appreciate simplicity. It's retro, it looks cool and it tells the time.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY023_DESC: There\xe2\x80\x99s never anything better than a black edition\xe2\x80\x94and whatever may hatch from the Tomogunchi Black will be no exception.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY024_DESC: Track your in-game steps and heart rate while you track your enemies - the watch keeps you honest.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY025_DESC: Time is the fire in which our K/D ratios burn. Keep track of it all with the Time to Die watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY027_DESC: Father Time is as old as the hills. This watch's retro look belies its stellar performance, however.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY028_DESC: This watch ranks as one of the most progressive out there. Oh, and it shows your rank progress too.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY029_DESC: You're always mission-aware with the Tactics Tracker Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY030_DESC: Show them what you've got with the Emblem Precision II Watch which displays your currently equipped Emblem on its face.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY031_DESC: A hidden engraving in the rear plate reads: "Five long years he wore this watch..."
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY033_DESC: Any watch will tell the time, but few do it in as classy a manner as the Inotay Retro.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY034_DESC: Count down to the apocalypse with the Radioactive Watch, which tracks your progress towards a Tactical Nuke.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY035_DESC: Get a little extra time with the Freeze Frame Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY050_DESC: Spring forward or fall back with the Time Traveler Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY053_DESC: Don't get caught hibernating with the Ursa Minor Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY054_DESC: No need to watch the sun. Use the Blue Skies Watch, son.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY055_DESC: The Clepsydra Watch would no doubt be as useful underwater as above it. It's just, how would you test something like that?
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY056_DESC: Times are changing, just check your watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY057_DESC: Time to watch the world burn. Introducing the Swiftlet Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY058_DESC: Take it one thing at a time with the Red Barchetta Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY059_DESC: The biological clock is a ticking timebomb. Keep an eye on it with the Acid Rain Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY060_DESC: Keep track of the tides of battle with the Flood Plain Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY061_DESC: They'll wind up dead when you wear the Winding Skull Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY062_DESC: Plans will go like clockwork when you all synchronize with the Hammer Down Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY063_DESC: Colorful dreams and sleeping on the job? Prevent malfunctions with the Chromatose Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY064_DESC: It\xe2\x80\x99s always a bloody good time with the Blood Simple Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY065_DESC: Beat more than Father Time with the Red Ratio Watch and keep track of your K/D ratio while you're at it.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY066_DESC: The Call of Duty: Mobile Watch is featherweight, reliable, and obnoxiously hard to lose.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY067_DESC: They don't know it yet, but they're living on borrowed time when you're wearing the Jackals Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY068_DESC: The fabled Chimera is a cobbled-together animal \xe2\x80\x93 which is in stark contrast to the beautiful precision analog timepiece.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY069_DESC: It's been calculated that one human hour equates to seven dog hours. The Demon Dogs Watch keeps regular people time however.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY070_DESC: Come correct and get buttoned up with the Warcom Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY071_DESC: The SAS Watch embodies one trait above all others: dependability
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY072_DESC: In Communist Russia, time kills you. The Spetsnaz Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY073_DESC: Evolve your pet after each match to unlock corresponding pet charms. Make sure to keep your pet good and fed!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY074_DESC: Make sure your opponents never miss their appointment with death when you wear your A Time To Reap Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY076_DESC: Always keep spatial awareness when utilizing the Mini Map watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY077_DESC: Don't you just love seeing how stuff works? The Sortie Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY079_DESC: Take no time off with the Willpower Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY081_DESC: Your opponents will never miss their appointment with death when you rock the Redline Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY082_DESC: Give out more than red cards with the Injury Time Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY083_DESC: Timing is everything with the Steadfast Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY084_DESC: Look for a sign with the Foreshadow Watch. Results may vary.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY085_DESC: Time your assault perfectly with the Treasure Trove Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY086_DESC: Take to the sea! It's the Angamos Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY087_DESC: Get out of the weeds with the Shadowy Moor Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY088_DESC: The Calamity Watch is quite unexpected, but very welcome.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY089_DESC: Contrary to its name, this watch hates the water.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY090_DESC: No splitting hairs with the Isotope Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY092_DESC: Take the first shift with the Night Watchman Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY093_DESC: Calculate your average kills with the Golden Mean Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY094_DESC: You losing? Something isn't adding up, better double check the math.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY095_DESC: How many kills did I get today? Let's add 'em up!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY096_DESC: Ever needed to know where North or South was in a pinch? Just look at the Four Winds Watch on your wrist!
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY098_DESC: Keep an eye on the time in style with the Strange Magic Watch.
ACCESSORY/ACCESSORY099_DESC: Time your opponent's demise with the Death Note Watch.
ACHIEVEMENTS/ACRAPPYWAYTODIE_DESC: Kill the enemy in the porta-potty.
ACHIEVEMENTS/BACKPACKGUY_DESC: Kill gassed or blinded enemies using a Molotov, Semtex and Frag in 'Prison Break'.
ACHIEVEMENTS/CROCODILE_DESC: Shoot three enemies while underwater in 'Wetwork'.
ACHIEVEMENTS/DAREDEVIL_DESC: While affected by one Flashbang, kill two enemies in the Campaign or in Co-op.
ACHIEVEMENTS/FLOORISLAVA_DESC: In 'Dark Water' advance 90 meters towards the front of the ship without touching the deck.
ACHIEVEMENTS/GENTLEMANTHIEF_DESC: Open three safes in the Campaign.
ACHIEVEMENTS/GHOSTINTRAINING_DESC: Reach the penthouse in 'El Sin Nombre' without killing anyone or triggering the alarm.
ACHIEVEMENTS/MUSTBEWIND_DESC: Rescue the hostages in 'Countdown' without the enemies firing their weapons.
ACHIEVEMENTS/NESSY_DESC: Reach the barge without being seen in 'Wetwork'.
ACHIEVEMENTS/NOALARMBADSIT_DESC: Complete 'Low Profile' without triggering any Alarms.
ACHIEVEMENTS/NOBODYWASTHERE_DESC: Never trigger the alarm in 'Recon by Fire'.
ACHIEVEMENTS/NOTIMETOLOSE_DESC: Complete the CCTV sequence in four minutes.
ACHIEVEMENTS/ONEHIJACK_DESC: Reach Price using the first vehicle you hijack.
ACHIEVEMENTS/ONESTARCP_DESC: Earn at least one Star in Co-op.
ACHIEVEMENTS/PRACTICEMAKESPERFECT_DESC: Shoot all the targets in the training area in 'Ghost Team'.
ACHIEVEMENTS/SPFINISH_DESC: Finish the Campaign on any difficulty.
ACHIEVEMENTS/TESTDRIVE_DESC: Drive five vehicle types in 'Violence and Timing'.
ACHIEVEMENTS/THREESTAROBSERVATORY_DESC: Earn three Stars in 'Defender: Mt. Zaya'.
ACHIEVEMENTS/VETFINISH_DESC: Finish all Campaign missions on Veteran or Realism difficulty.
ACHIEVEMENTS/WALLOFDUTY_DESC: Kill three Enemies with the Riot Shield in the Campaign or in Co-op.

Kill a boss and extract their weapon case.

CINEMATICS/CAPTIVE_DESC: With the Wolf dead, but Hadir and the gas still at large, Farah\xe2\x80\x99s forces are put on the Foreign Terrorist Organization list. Alex chooses to stay with Farah\xe2\x80\x99s army.
CINEMATICS/EPILOGUE_DESC: In the wake of their success against Barkov, Price and Laswell discuss the formation of new task force called \xe2\x80\x9c141.\xe2\x80\x9d
CINEMATICS/ESTATE_DESC: On the heels of a trying interrogation of the Butcher, Price and Kyle race to intercept Hadir at Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s estate as Kyle questions where they draw the line.
CINEMATICS/HIGHWAY_DESC: Farah hatches a plan to ambush the Wolf on the \xe2\x80\x9cHighway of Death\xe2\x80\x9d before he can escape to the mountains.
CINEMATICS/LAB_DESC: Hadir discovers the location of Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s gas factory but is apprehended by Price and Kyle. Laswell gives Hadir to the Russians. Price asks Farah to help him destroy the lab.
CINEMATICS/MARINES_DESC: Alex and Farah prep for a mission to capture the Wolf. Farah explains that anyone who uses terrorist tactics is her enemy, without exception.
CINEMATICS/PICCADILLY_DESC: After terrorists steal Russian gas from General Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s PMCs, Laswell calls Captain John Price for help with recovering the stolen chemicals and de-escalating tensions with Russia.
CINEMATICS/PROXYWAR_DESC: CIA Station Chief Kate Laswell commands an operation with Ground Branch officer Alex and Marine Raiders to intercept a chemical weapons shipment bound for Urzikstan.
CINEMATICS/SACRIFICE_DESC: The team plants charges to demolish Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s gas facility but the detonator is damaged. Alex volunteers to sacrifice himself and set off the explosions manually.
CINEMATICS/SAFEHOUSE_DESC: When Al-Qatala claims responsibility for a London attack, SAS Sgt. Kyle Garrick wants to escalate. Alex meets with militia Commander Karim to join forces in pursuit of the stolen gas.
CINEMATICS/SAFEHOUSEFINALE_DESC: From Hadir\xe2\x80\x99s safehouse, Hadir and Alex prep for an assault on General Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s airbase.
CINEMATICS/STPETERSBURG_DESC: Then: Lt. Price helps rescue Farah and Hadir from Barkov\xe2\x80\x99s POW camp. Now: intel says Hadir is planning an attack in Russia. Price and Laswell launch a covert mission to stop it.
CINEMATICS/TOWNHOUSED_DESC: Kyle\xe2\x80\x99s intel leads to a raid on a London townhouse where the Al-Qatala terror cell is holed-up.
CINEMATICS/TUNNELS_DESC: Upon discovering that her brother Hadir is responsible for stealing the Russian gas, and is now in Al-Qatala\xe2\x80\x99s hands, Farah vows to hunt him down alongside Price\xe2\x80\x99s team.

CP_INTEL/AAR_ASSESSMENT_ANIYAH_ALLIES: Allegiance forces engaged indigenous fighters and western assets in contest for the Urzikstani Presidential Palace, indicating a power play in the region. Orders to disengage resulted in successful Allegiance capture of the palace, denying victory to the people of Urzikstan.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ASSESSMENT_ANIYAH_AXIS: During their successful raid and capture of the Urzikstani Presidential Palace, Allegiance forces encountered a combined force of Coalition soldiers and indigenous fighters confirmed to be Al-Qatala. Both forces appeared to be fighting in unison, suggesting that a splinter faction of the Coalition may be operating in conjunction with Al-Qatala. Evidence should be presented to Allegiance command at once.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ASSESSMENT_CAVES_ALLIES: Lighthouse 2 reacted with appropriate force when engaged by a hostile Allegiance element. Allegiance objective at Alzilu Alsayf unclear. Anti-aircraft guns used to engage Coalition UAV presumed to be Al-Qatala operated, but Allegiance may have been responsible. Their attempt to recover aforementioned blackbox, and their willingness to use engage Lighthouse 2, recommends this possibility.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ASSESSMENT_CAVES_AXIS: Kurgan 1 acted in appropriate defense from a hostile Coalition force, resulting in casualties on both sides. Rules of engagement observed. Status of Coalition asset (UAV) unknown, presumed recovered by Coalition. Al-Qatala presence successfully eliminated- AQ reoccupation of Alzilu Alsayf probable without Allegiance occupation.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER_ALLIES: Arrowhead 3 identified a known ultranationalist associate in direct communication with Allegiance personnel on the ground. ROEs were properly observed, returning fire as a last resort. Level of Allegiance resistance supports possibility of collaboration between Sokolov, Mr. Z, and Allegiance forces, though a splinter Allegiance group may be responsible.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER_AXIS: All efforts made to avoid direct conflict with Coalition forces, mitigating risk of open hostilities. Coalition presence in this territory could indicate increased hostility toward Allegiance-protected territories. However, first shots fired from Sokolov Facility were not fired by Omega 1 or any Allegiance force. Recommend forced occupation of the Sokolov Facility and increased Allegiance presence in the region.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_1_ANIYAH_ALL: Warrior 1 surrounds target perimeter. Reaver 2 sweeps the exterior grounds, dropping 3 AQ patrols. No alarms raised.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_1_ANIYAH_AXI: Blacksmith 4 returns fire to cover active infiltration. Squads fast-rope into the palace grounds, take position, and engage the enemy.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_1_CAVES_ALLI: Allegiance force opens small arms fire, wounding Lighthouse 2-0 in command. Lighthouse 2 returns fire, secures 2-0, and secures crashsite.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_1_CAVES_AXIS: Kurgan 1 arrives on station, begins house-to-house sweep- 14 AQ combatants killed. Progressed into caves, clearing small security force- 8 AQ combatants. No casualties reported.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_1_RUNNER_ALL: Identifies Allegiance forces on the ground in the facility- in verbal contact with owner/proprietor Leonid Sokolov- known associate of arms dealer "Mr. Z". Governor 1 relays orders to hold position and report changes.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_1_RUNNER_AXI: Omega 1 forces entry through the main gate and begin sweep of Sokolov Facility and surrounding area. Omega 1-1 in command questions Sokolov.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_2_ANIYAH_ALL: Reaver 2 moves interior, Warrior 1 occupies grounds. Reaver 2 goes loud, executes room to room sweep. North, south, and west palace wings clear.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_2_ANIYAH_AXI: Blacksmith 4 kills 12/18 identified AQ targets. Additional enemy forces exit the palace and engage.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_2_CAVES_ALLI: Heavy fire sustained from occupying Allegiance force. Orders received to press enemy back into the caves, providing cover for blackbox recovery and emergency egress.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_2_CAVES_AXIS: AQ A-A fire observed from western horizon. RU-00 reports Coalition UAV on approach for emergency landing.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_2_RUNNER_ALL: Unmarked convoy arrives at the main gate, prompting an apparent argument between Sokolov and Allegiance personnel.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_2_RUNNER_AXI: Unmarked convoy arrives at the gate, Omega 1-1 reports to RU 03 and gives order to search the trucks. Sokolov protests.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_3_ANIYAH_ALL: Warrior 1 engages unknown targets outside the palace grounds. Reaver 2 clears east wing of remaining AQ, then moves exterior to support.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_3_ANIYAH_AXI: Blacksmith 4-1 in command receives unconfirmed reports of Coalition forces among the AQ fighters. RU 03 gives full authority to engage.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_3_CAVES_ALLI: Allegiance forces pressed into retreat, egressing to emergency LZ for B-Lima extraction.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_3_CAVES_AXIS: UAV crash landing- center of target village. RU-00 reports Coalition recovery force on approach- gives order to egress and extract.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_3_RUNNER_ALL: Arrowhead 3 begins taking sniper fire from several vectors within the facility.  Governor 1 denies the request to engage, orders Arrowhead 3 to egress to secondary LZ.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_3_RUNNER_AXI: Shots fired from windows within the facility. Omega 1-1 orders defensive posture. Targets are identified in the southern forest. RU 03 gives order to intercept and detain.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_4_ANIYAH_ALL: Reaver 2 confirms Allegiance contact. Reaver 2 and Warrior 1 set perimeter and hold defense. Warrior 1 sustains heavy casualties.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_4_ANIYAH_AXI: Enemy forces routed- full retreat. Blacksmith 4 moves in to clear and secure the palace compound, ordering Blacksmith 4-5 and 4-6 to maintain fire on retreating force.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_4_CAVES_ALLI: All Coalition wounded accounted for and prepped for CASEVAC; 4 Allegiance KIA. Blackbox recovered from aircraft prior to thermite demolition. Lighthouse 2 execute sweep of caves, discovering multiple caches of Al-Qatala weaponry. Timed charges set prior to egress/exfil.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_4_CAVES_AXIS: Coalition force arrives. Attempts to contact met with small arms fire. Kurgan takes firing positions in buildings and caves; returns fire. 5 Coalition units down, Kurgan 1, 2 units.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_4_RUNNER_ALL: Allegiance forces cut off Arrowhead 3 retreat, forcing engagement inside the facility. Visual lost on Sokolov.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_4_RUNNER_AXI: Sokolov retreats. Coalition forces arrive in the facility, engaging Omega 1. RU 03 gives command to return fire and cover retreat.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_5_ANIYAH_ALL: Governor 1 gives order to cut bait and egress to designated LZ. Reaver 2-1 requests to hold position- denied.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_5_ANIYAH_AXI: Blacksmith 4 confirms Coalition units and Al-Qatala fighters among the dead.
CP_INTEL/AAR_ENGAGEMENTTEXT_5_RUNNER_ALL: Taking casualties, Allegiance forces retreat through the main gate. Arrowhead 3 secures the facility. Identifies shipment as chem-bio, coupled with missile stockpiles in the railhouse. Chem-bio tagged for EOD recovery, thermite set for missile demolition.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXFILTEXT_ANIYAH_ALLIES: Reaver 2 egress under fire to designated LZ in city ruins northeast of the palace. Remaining Warrior 1 forces scatter into the surrounding area.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXFILTEXT_ANIYAH_AXIS: Occupation force Horseman 2 arrives to assume control of the palace. Blacksmith 4 moves to exfil from the main courtyard.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXFILTEXT_CAVES_ALLIES: Lighthouse 2 egress to rendezvous with truck convoy.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXFILTEXT_CAVES_AXIS: B-Lima exfil arrives on station. Kurgan 1 moves to egress under fire- minimal injuries sustained.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXFILTEXT_RUNNER_ALLIES: Arrowhead 3 egress to rendezvous at secondary LZ for extraction.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXFILTEXT_RUNNER_AXIS: Omega 1 egress under fire to light vehicle convoy and proceed en route to Yaschuk Farm.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXTRACTTEXT_ANIYAH_AXIS: Blacksmith 4 arrives at Outpost Forerunner for debrief.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXTRACTTEXT_CAVES_ALLIES: Lighthouse 2 proceed southbound on Tariq Almawt to Coalition safehouse/airfield, Alfidiya.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXTRACTTEXT_CAVES_AXIS: Extraction to Riddam successful. All casualties recovered.
CP_INTEL/AAR_EXTRACTTEXT_RUNNER_AXIS: Omega 1 arrive at Yaschuk Farm. 3 wounded, prepped for evacuation.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INFILTEXT_ANIYAH_ALLIES: Reaver 2 and Warrior 1 arrive at LZ bravo, 1 klick from target. Proceed on foot to palace perimeter.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INFILTEXT_ANIYAH_AXIS: Blacksmith 4 arrive on target, immediately engaged by AQ targets on the palace grounds.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INFILTEXT_CAVES_ALLIES: Lighthouse 2 arrives on station, identifies Allegiance force holding on crashsite, working to extract onboard storage. Demon Dogs TL gives order to "confront" Allegiance, not engage.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INFILTEXT_CAVES_AXIS: Aerial infil B-Lima departs Riddam, bound for Alzilu Alsayf. Surveillance reports minimal activity in village.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INFILTEXT_RUNNER_ALLIES: Arrowhead arrives on station, south of the target area.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INFILTEXT_RUNNER_AXIS: Omega 1 convoy arrives at Sokolov Facility. Greeted at the gate by Leonid Sokolov but denied entry.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INSERTEXT_ANIYAH_ALLIES: Reaver 2 and Warrior 1 rendezvous at Coalition Airfield Hotel-51, 10 klicks from target. Dust off in light helo squad Nomad 2.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INSERTEXT_ANIYAH_AXIS: Blacksmith 4 rally at Outpost Forerunner. Board B-Lima helos for transport to target, 5 km distance.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INSERTEXT_CAVES_ALLIES: Lighthouse 2 convoy travelling westbound on 'Tariq Almawta'1 km from target, rerouted for emergency retrieval.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INSERTEXT_CAVES_AXIS: Kurgan 1 rallies at abandoned village of Riddam, 3 km northeast of target.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INSERTEXT_RUNNER_ALLIES: Arrowhead 3 rendezvous at Arklov Peak Military Base in northern Verdansk. Board light helicopter group Leatherback 1 for aerial infil.
CP_INTEL/AAR_INSERTEXT_RUNNER_AXIS: Omega 1 rally for patrol at Yaschuk Farm, northeast of Verdansk. Boarded light vehicle convoy for patrol.
CP_INTEL/AAR_MISSION_ANIYAH_ALLIES: Coalition strike force (callsign Reaver 2,) LF force (callsign Warrior 1,) Governor 1 overwatch. Former Presidential Palace of Urzikstan occupied by Al-Qatala, taken from rogue Gen. Roman Barkov. Reaver 2 tasked with securing the palace grounds and interior for handoff to LF control. Allegiance forces arrived, engaged Reaver 2 and LF forces on the ground.
CP_INTEL/AAR_MISSION_ANIYAH_AXIS: Allegiance operation force, callsign Blacksmith 4, RU 03 in command. Unrest in the region caused by the criminal Roman Barkov allowed Al-Qatala to occupy the former Presidential Palace of Urzikstan. Blacksmith 4 ordered to infiltrate, clear, and secure the palace for Allegiance control. Encountered and repelled both Al-Qatala and Coalition forces on the ground.
CP_INTEL/AAR_MISSION_CAVES_ALLIES: Coalition QRF, callsign Lighthouse 2, Demon Dogs TL overwatch. Coalition UAV reported shot down by Al-Qatala forces based in Alzilu Alsayf village, Urzikstan. QRF dispatched to clear village of AQ fighters, secure the crashsite, recover UAV blackbox, and demo the aircraft. Allegiance QRF spotted on approach, restricting ROEs to defensive posture.
CP_INTEL/AAR_MISSION_CAVES_AXIS: 10 Allegiance Special Infantry (Callsign "Kurgan") with RU-00 overwatch. Infiltrate, secure, and capture known Al-Qatala stronghold and cave complex- Alzilu Alsayf village, Urzikstan. Surveillance indicated frequent shipments moving through caves, supplying AQ insurgents in the central and southeast region. Primary objective to sever flow of weapons/materiel and gather intel to identify supply routes and sources.
CP_INTEL/AAR_MISSION_RUNNER_ALLIES: Coalition recon force, callsign Arrowhead 3, Governor 1 overwatch. Intel identified the Sokolov Mining and Lumber facility (northern Kastovia mountains) as a potential chem-bio storage facility tied to rogue Gen. Roman Barkov. Arrowhead 3 tasked with surveillance; dispatched to infil the surrounding forest and recon the facility. Allegiance force identified on site, restricting ROEs to defensive posture.
CP_INTEL/AAR_MISSION_RUNNER_AXIS: Allegiance patrol, callsign Omega 1, RU 03 overwatch. Reports indicated unidentified convoys traveling rural backroads around Verdansk. Omega 1 received orders to make contact with Leonid Sokolov of the Sokolov Mining and Lumber facility- known smuggler and top of the list for questioning. Unidentified snipers were spotted in the surrounding forest, prompting swift action by Omega 1.

CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_ALICE:
-Joined US Army at 18. Excelled in written, cognitive, and physical performance. 4 incident reports on file, reporting \xe2\x80\x9cdisciplinary issues\xe2\x80\x9d and \xe2\x80\x9cproblems with authority.\xe2\x80\x9d
-Entered and passed selection for Task Force Orange with noted reservation by Senior Drill Sergeant, SFC. William Griggs \xe2\x80\x93 cousin of Sgt. Marcus Griggs USMC. (Demon Dogs CO)
-Deployed to Afghanistan in 2010. Served with Task Force Orange for 4 years until incident in Kandahar province involving Coalition operator \xe2\x80\x9cDDay.\xe2\x80\x9d (see below)
-Reassigned to support roles for following 3 years, including training Afghan female soldiers.
-Filed numerous requests for combat assignment. Chosen for Demon Dogs in October 2019.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_AZUR:
-Known arms dealer, based in Alexandria, Egypt- active across Northern Africa from 2007 to present day.
-No formal military or combat experience prior. Began hiring private instructors after the murder of wife (Atiya) and children (Azima and Samman) at the hands of Al-Qatala enforcer Jamal Rahar, AKA \xe2\x80\x9cThe Butcher;\xe2\x80\x9d an apparent reprisal over an arms deal with AQ rival CHIMERA.
-Following death of family, entered combat training by various private sources- western and eastern PMCs (CHIMERA included) over 6 years.
-Entered long-term partnership with pan-African revolutionary group \xe2\x80\x9cthe Jackals,\xe2\x80\x9d consolidating influence across the continent. Currently less than 1 year of active involvement.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_BALE:
-Served 14 total years in Spetsnaz, Spetsgruppa A \xe2\x80\x93 Alpha Group, Counter-Terrorism. Achieved rank of St\xc3\xa1rshiy serzh\xc3\xa1nt (Staff Sergeant.)
-Gravely wounded (GSW, C6 spinal cord injury) during Kurbanov Hospital siege, 2nd Chechen War.
-Allowed to continue active duty in GRU administrative role. Fully rehabilitated over 5 years.
-Passed physical requirements for readmission into Alpha Group- April, 2014.
-Served 6 mo. under Gen. Barkov (Urzikstan) until filing formal complaint, citing civilian deaths.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_CHARLY:
-Trained in tracking techniques from age 8 to 18 by father Cpt. Craig Johnstone, hunting poachers in Kenya and Tanzania.
-Joined British Army in 2005 to follow family tradition. Applied for and passed selection for the Special Reconnaissance Regiment (SRR.)
-Served multiple tours in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya. Paired with Lt. Jacob Micah Thorne, SAS, from 2011-present. Together, they maintain an 84.4% success rate (by Coalition figures.)
-Orchestrated the successful defense and liberation of a CIA safehouse in southern Urzikstan, earning a friend in Case Officer Kate Laswell, CIA.
-Al-Qatala attack on Piccadilly Circus solidified the SAS/SRR commitment to the Coalition. History with Laswell ensured assignment of operators Johnstone and Thorne.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_DDAY:
-Joined US Army on 18th birthday, 6 days after September 11th, 2001. Passed US Army Ranger school, May 2002. Deployed to Afghanistan in Operation Enduring Freedom, June 2002.
-Redeployed to Iraq for Operation Iraqi Freedom; fought in 1st and 2nd battles for Fallujah.
-Redeployed to Afghanistan for 2009 troop surge. Worked in extensive cooperation with Task Force Orange for 5 years until incident in Kandahar province involving Coalition operator \xe2\x80\x9cAlice.\xe2\x80\x9d (see below) Subsequently issued Section 8 Discharge, sent home to El Paso, TX.
-Returned to Afghanistan with PMC group Hadrian Defense Solutions. Recruited for Demon Dogs by Coalition operator Alice in October 2019.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_DOMINO:
-Trained since 16 years of age to represent France in the Summer Olympics (Track and Field.) Failed to qualify for 2012. On track to qualify for 2016. Changed focus after Al-Qatala attacks on Paris, joining French Army.
-Selected for French Special Forces. Exhibited extraordinary physical fitness and cognitive ability. Broke 3 regiment records.
-Sent to Urzikstan in 2017 for first combat deployment, tasked with supporting Coalition forces.
-Hand-picked to represent France in WARCOM.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_GOLEM:
-Raised in Oberstdorf, Germany. Taught the arts of bow hunting and wilderness tracking by father, Col. Daniel Blaustein, on frequent excursions into the German/Austrian Alps.
-Joined the Bundeswehr at 18, following family tradition established post World War 2.
-Passed selection for Kommando Spezialkr\xc3\xa4fte (KSK) 4th Platoon- special geographic operations.
-KSK deployments remain classified. Intel suggests operations in Mozambique, Urzikstan, and the Kastovian Mountains.
-Enjoys a sterling reputation with KSK, despite investigation of Operation Nachtigall (see below.)
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_GRINCH:
-Training and military background unknown. Appears educated in both Coalition and Allegiance battle doctrines combined with self-taught survivalism.
-\xe2\x80\x9cDiscovered\xe2\x80\x9d by Jackals patrol through the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) lead by Cpt. Zane (fmr. Nigerian Army, 7th Infantry Division.)
-3 Jackals fighters were reportedly killed by improvised traps and sniper fire while passing through a derelict jungle village occupied by Grinch. Cpt. Zane negotiated a cease fire and subsequent contract with operator Grinch. Currently 2 years of active service.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_KRUEGER:
-Joined the German Bundeswehr under assumed identity \xe2\x80\x9cJosef Doss.\xe2\x80\x9d Now known to have been evading homicide charges in Salzburg, Austria (never convicted.)
-Received exceptional marks in Long Range Surveillance training and subsequent selection process for the Kommando Spezialkr\xc3\xa4fte (KSK.) Inducted into KSK 4th Platoon after 3 years.
-Removed from active duty pending court-martial for suspected role in civilian killings during 04/12/18 \xe2\x80\x9cOperation Nachtigall,\xe2\x80\x9d Mozambique. Escaped KSK custody 04/15.
-Fled to Eastern Europe (location unknown,) made contact with CHIMERA mercenary group. Entered long-term contract- currently 2 years in active service.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_MINOTAUR:
-Served 5 total years in Spetsnaz, Spetsgruppa A \xe2\x80\x93 Alpha Group, Counter-Terrorism. Achieved rank of Serzh\xc3\xa1nt (Sergeant.)
-Witnessed wounding of brother SSgt. Dmitry Bale during Kurbanov Hospital siege, 2nd Chechen War (2009.) Falsely informed of brother Dmitry\xe2\x80\x99s death. Discharged for psychological trauma.
-Spent following 10 years in and out of PMC groups operating in Southeast Asia under assumed alias Sergei Krovopuskov. Holds outstanding warrants for felonies in Cambodia, Laos, and Thailand.
-Tracked down by SSgt. Bale, July 2019. Requested for Allegiance Operator Status, Nov 2019.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_OTTER:
-Orphaned at 3 years of age, raised as a \xe2\x80\x9cward of the state.\xe2\x80\x9d Juvenile criminal record includes several counts of larceny, burglary, vandalism, public intoxication, and aggravated assault.
-Gained international fame in June 2011 (aged 19.) Thwarted an Al-Qatala knife attack in Hyde Park, London- beat suspect unconscious while onlookers watched and recorded the event.
-Joined British Commandos in August 2011. Thrived in training. Entered SAS selection on recommendation by senior officers. Passed selection in January 2012.
-Deployed to operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Libya, Somalia, Yemen, and finally Urzikstan. Known to have served under Cpt. John Price in at least 7 operations.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_RAINES:
-Joined US Marine Corps in 2006. Received top marks in recruit training.
-Served as a Marine Radio Operator in the Iraq War 2007-2009, utilized in infantry, armored, and finally special reconnaissance. Developed reputation as a fearless, \xe2\x80\x9claser-focused\xe2\x80\x9d Marine.
-Passed selection to become a Marine Raider. Served with distinction in Iraq until redeployment to Afghanistan, 2011-2015 assigned at the end to training Afghan Security Forces. Correspondence with family suggests retirement considered.
-Reached out to friend/fellow soldier Sgt. Marcus Griggs USMC (Demon Dogs) to solicit help in reassignment. Immediately referred/deployed to Urzikstan to serve with the Demon Dogs.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_RODION:
-Served 2 years in Spetsnaz 24th Special Purpose Brigade in Irkutsk, specializing in state-of-the-art and prototype weapons systems.
-Applied for selection into Spetsgruppa "B" or \xe2\x80\x9cVympel,\xe2\x80\x9d specifically targeting a career in counter-terrorism operations. Cited desire to \xe2\x80\x9cfight real evil,\xe2\x80\x9d referring to Al-Qatala operations in Urzikstan and abroad.
-Passed Vympel selection after 18 months. Deployed directly into Allegiance active duty by request of Sgt. Kamarov- apparently hand-picked for expertise in Western culture.
-Verdansk appears to be first CT deployment in an active combat zone.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_SYD:
-Joined US Army at 18, seeking overseas deployment and combat experience.
-Stationed by [REDACTED] request to Yambol Province, Bulgaria. Enrolled in every available training course during 4 year term of service (completed.)
-Records inconsistent over next 5 years. Reports indicate travel to conflict zones including (but not limited to) Ukraine, Urzikstan, and Mozambique. Presumed employment as a PMC.
-Signed long-term contract with CHIMERA- currently 1 year of active service.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_THORNE:
-Joined the RAF at 18. Entered and passed SAS selection at 23, honoring family tradition.
-Served with distinction under Cpt. Johnathan Price, SAS for 3 years, operating in Iraq, Afghanistan, Urzikstan, and Kastovia (classified.)
-Formally filed for transfer from Cpt. Price\xe2\x80\x99s command in 2011, citing ethical concerns. Reportedly present for the unsanctioned capture and interrogation of suspected ultranationalists in Kastovia.
-Chose officer\xe2\x80\x99s track in effort to \xe2\x80\x9clead by example.\xe2\x80\x9d Achieved rank of Lieutenant in 2014. Given command of an SAS platoon, and paired with Lt. Charlotte Johnstone (Charly) of the SRR.
-Hand-picked by the Director Special Forces (DSF) to represent the SAS in the Coalition. Intercepted messages indicate DSF intent to monitor Cpt. Price. Counter-intelligence possible.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_WYATT:
-Born in rural Tasmania- raised on long distance camping expeditions and wilderness training.
-Joined Australian Army with all 3 brothers in 2010. Each served full tours in Afghanistan- separate postings. Brothers returned to Tasmania.
-Chose a military career, accepted into Australian Special Forces \xe2\x80\x93 1st Commando Regiment, October 2012.
-Known deployments in Afghanistan from 2012 to 2014, followed by operations in Urzikstan from 2015 to present day.
-Coalition psych-eval notes pronounced affinity for extreme, dangerous scenarios. Recommended for WARCOM/Coalition selection by Cpl. Benjamin \xe2\x80\x9cOtter\xe2\x80\x9d Lee (SAS.)
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_YEGOR:
-Served full 2 year term in the Ukranian Naval Infantry.
-Entered private sector after discharge. Used Navy contacts across the Black Sea for both white and black market shipping. Came to deal exclusively in illegal arms and cigarettes.
-Forced out of Ukraine by former partners in the Sokolov Crime Family after reportedly refusing to broker a weapons deal with known ultranationalist Imran Zakhaev.
-Entered long-term contract with CHIMERA, expanding contacts across Eastern Europe- currently 8 years of active service.
CP_INTEL/BILLET_HISTORY_ZANE:
-Served 12 years in the Nigerian Army- 1 Division, 3 Armoured Division, and 7th Infantry Division. Achieved the rank of Captain.
-Resigned post April 2nd, 2016 in protest, having filed 3 formal complaints alleging misappropriation of foreign aid intended for the fight against Al-Qatala in West Africa.
-Left with brother, Abraham Metiko and founded the Jackals PMC Group. Began recruiting and training troops from across Africa \xe2\x80\x9cin defense of our countries, our families, and our way of life.\xe2\x80\x9d
-Financed primarily by black market petroleum and illegal arms sales, the Jackals are officially designated a \xe2\x80\x9cterrorist group\xe2\x80\x9d by the Nigerian Government and Coalition forces.

MP_DMZ_NOTES/AGENT01:
^BPrinted Document^R

Target <redacted> has arrived in the AO at <redacted>.

Agent <redacted> activated for covert Operation <redacted>.

Observe, record, report, then execute. Leave your notes behind for Agent <redacted> who will be shadowing you at a distance.

Use code 17912SB for full mission details. This is not a drill.

<Fuzzy picture of target attached>
MP_DMZ_NOTES/AGENT02:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Entry 1:
Observing Al Mazrah from long range. Target arrival confirmed.

Target observed moving through Taraq, so this location no longer viable.

Going to explore the Pass for any clues.

Entry 2:
Explored Al Sharim Pass. This is definitely an AQ hideout. Need to\xe2\x80\xa6

<writing looks interrupted>

Position compromised. Moving West to link up with target again.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/AGENT03:
^BScribbled Notes^R

Entry 5:
Tracked target to Sa\xe2\x80\x99id shopping center. Using security cameras to acquire visual and audio recordings. 
Confirmed meeting at the restaurant on the waterfront with <redacted>. Moving to overlook. Will engage targets.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/AGENT04:
^BScribbled Notes^R

Entry 7:
Both targets spotted at restaurant. Swirling winds off the water caused me to miss my shot. Waiting...

They are headed this way. Leaving some of my gear behind so I can move faster. Going to make a break for the safe house 3. Engaging Evacuation Protocol 27.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/AGENT05:
^BScribbled Notes^R

Entry 8:
Arrived at safe house, but think I was followed. Need to lay low here for a couple of days. Shutting down all electronics so I can\xe2\x80\x99t be tracked. If you find this, I am probably already compromised and captured and Protocol 27 has failed.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/ANTI_AIR:
^BPrinted Document^R

Make sure this shipment gets to <redacted> ASAP.

It contains highly valuable materials and they do not take failure well. We expect utmost secrecy on this job, so keep off radios and no unscheduled stops.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CAPTURED01:
^BScribbled Note^R

I\xe2\x80\x99m holed up in this tiny room and I can hear them all around me. I\xe2\x80\x99m almost out of ammo and I think they know it. This might be my last message ever. 

Please, if anyone find this\xe2\x80\xa6please tell my wife and son I love them.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CAPTURED02:
^BJournal Entry^R

Subject: Western fighter 

Condition: Weakened from many hours of interrogation. 

Notes: Keep pressing him for information about western forces arriving at the warzone. Will need to move him soon.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CAPTURED03:
^BJournal Entry^R

Subject: Western fighter

Condition: Remains weakened, but also vigilant.

Notes: Fighter mentions something about an invasion. Unsure if he is delirious or speaking of something even bigger than a ground war. We need to move him again.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CAPTURED04:
^BScribbled Note^R

Passing lies. They know nothing. Rumors of an oasis HQ to the north. I will be moved there soon.

0213
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CARTEL01:
^BLogbook^R

First meeting with the new seller went as well as can be expected. I think they can provide us what we want, but I am still not sure this arrangement doesn\xe2\x80\x99t come without problems.

We\xe2\x80\x99ve discussed the use of the north runway for deliveries. It will attract less attention until we fully control the airport. They are very familiar with small plane deliveries of sensitive cargo.

We should move forward with a more formal meeting with the elders.

Code: 7 9 8 1
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CARTEL02:
^BScrawled Note^R

Las Almas offering more weapons than that tiny runway can handle. Damn it.

Need to use Al Malik for deliveries.

At least plenty of storage here.

Move soldiers to the main terminal to make sure we are secure.

Authorization: Rebel 19
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CARTEL03:
^BShipment Logbook^R

Received first test shipment @ 0400 under cover of darkness. Worked well, but is not necessary.

Shipment manifest accounted for. We can handle more weapons than this. 

Moving shipment to more secure location for further inspection.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CARTEL04:
^BScrawled Note^R

Shipment arrived safely, but I think some pieces went missing.

Need to interrogate everyone involved in the transfer.

The thief must be caught and punished.

Need to move the shipment again, but quietly.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CARTEL05:
^BTalking Points for a Meeting^R

-Relationship that will be of great benefit for both of us.

-Find thief and deal with them swiftly

-Increase deliveries ASAP (no need for night drops)

-Discuss larger arms\xe2\x80\xa6the heavy stuff.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CHEMIST01:
^BScrawled Reporter's Notes^R

Radio chatter of some rogue AQ scientist in the area.

Could this be the operative known as \xe2\x80\x9cThe Chemist\xe2\x80\x9d??

\xe2\x80\xa6rumor was he died in one of his experiments?

Source X gave me the address for his lab, home\xe2\x80\xa6something. 

Need to investigate. Need to be careful.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CHEMIST02:
^BMeticulously Written Journal^R

Entry 1:
They do not understand me. They do not understand what this can do.
They think this is a game, but it is not. I am so close to understanding how it expands. How it spreads.

I am going to ask for formal authorization to run my experiments.

Entry 4:
My inquiry was rejected. I need to take matters into my own hands.
I am recruiting a group to help me. We will go into the radiation ourselves.

I need to run some more tests in the old lab to make sure we are on the right track.

Entry 5: 
Code: 1921BRN + 7SLN9 (make sure to wait 10 seconds)
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CHEMIST03:
^BMeticulously Written Journal^R

Entry 10:
Ambient air here is perfect for this test today. Administering micro dose again.

Lack of available test subject is troubling. Need to consider other options.

Entry 11:
I have decided to administer the micro does to myself. Exposure via micro dose is perfect for this. I may even be able to build up a temporary immunity. Further experiments are required.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CHEMIST04:
^BSloppy Journal Scrap^R

Entry 15:
Some of the others asked me to leave. How dare\xe2\x80\xa6<illegible>..when this close.

<illegible> has been painful and\xe2\x80\xa6<illegible> \xe2\x80\xa6going to have to consider going inside.

Entry 16:
<illegible> have given me some loyal followers and guards. They will be protecting my work in the <illegible>. 

I have some amazing news to report, but can\xe2\x80\x99t remain here. Need to move towards Al-Safwa Quarry.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/CHEMIST05:
^BJournal of a Mad Man^R

Final Entry:
<illegible> my completed first assessment of the anomaly in its entirety. <illegible> and I will be moving out soon directly into the beast for an all-new experiment. So far, every attempt to contain the anomaly has failed and lead to death. Furthermore, <illegible> and I don\xe2\x80\x99t expect to come back, so I am leaving these notes behind for someone else to find. I have also sent a duplicate copy on a thumb drive to the appropriate person. 

Remember MoD3S - 77

Wish me luck. I go to <illegible>
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY01:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Family, 

It\xe2\x80\x99s time to leave. Al Qatala forces are moving in so fast that I fear for our lives. I fear we are on the verge of all being told to evacuate anyway so let\xe2\x80\x99s get ahead of this.

I will be heading out immediately to gather my belonging at meet at the place we said we would if it ever came to this. I\xe2\x80\x99ve left some stuff around here. Please take what you need and get moving.

-Fahad
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY02:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Rajah,

My family is leaving here as soon as we can. I am not sure when we will return, if ever. I\xe2\x80\x99ve gathered my belongings and left some other items behind. If there\xe2\x80\x99s anything you want, please feel free to take it and make sure you lock the shop up tight when you go.

Travel safely. Hope to see you again some day.

-Fahad
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY03:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Hasina, 

They are telling us to leave now. My father said he\xe2\x80\x99s not going to wait, so I don\xe2\x80\x99t know what to do. I want to see you again. I want you to come with me. 


I wish you would answer your phone and I hope you are ok. We are all meeting at the shop I told you about. Please, if you see this come as soon as you can. Grab anything in the apartment. You might need it.

-Dabir
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY04:
^BQuickly Scrawled Written Note^R

Dabir,

I came as quickly as I could. My phone died and I can\xe2\x80\x99t get back into downtown Al Mazrah without being detained. I thought you might head here, but clearly you haven\xe2\x80\x99t been here in some time.

I\xe2\x80\x99m going to try to make it to the East. I\xe2\x80\x99m going to stay off the roads as much as I can. I hope to see you soon.

-Hasina
MP_DMZ_NOTES/FAMILY05:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Hasina, we waited as long as we could. I am so sorry. Our escort is here and they are already threatening to leave.

I have left supplies around the shop. They are all for you. Be safe and I hope you and Dabir can meet up again some day. No one expected this day would come so soon.

To anyone else who finds this, please take whatever you find in my shop if you need it to survive. We all much stick together\xe2\x80\xa6
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HANDWRITTEN_NOTE_DESC: Sheet of paper with a handwritten note.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HOARD01:
^BOfficial Note^R

Chief,

We\xe2\x80\x99ve locked up as many weapons as we could find in the main locker room. I have the key, but I know it\xe2\x80\x99s not the only one. Some of the officers have standard issue keys to the room. I\xe2\x80\x99ve locked each locker as well. 

Let\xe2\x80\x99s hope these weapons don\xe2\x80\x99t fall into the wrong hands.

- Officer K.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HOARD02:
^BHandwritten Note^R

Weapon inventory has revealed some weapons missing from this lockup. Additional weapons have been moved to Sawah Village. 

I left a key to the lockers here. Please take what you need but save some for others. Defend this location at all costs.

-Kamal
MP_DMZ_NOTES/HOARD03:
^BHandwritten Note^R

The last of our weapons remain here. We need to hold out as long as we can. Let us hope that the water levels do not rise and flood this room. 

Be well and good luck.

-Kamal

MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO01:
^BNote From Sailor to Captain^R

Captain, we found this in his bunk. The journal was damaged, but I transcribed what I could make out...

\xe2\x80\x9cThis boat. This sea. I may never come back.

Once upon a time, two of us ate SEVEN whole loaves of bread and called it good.

\xe2\x80\xa6why does that banging never stop?

I think the captain wants me, Samum, locked up. I should make sure he doesn\xe2\x80\x99t find these notes.

They know it was me who started the fire. I can hear them coming down the hall.

They think they have me trapped. I may need to jump overboard\xe2\x80\xa6and off to Taraq.\xe2\x80\x9d
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO02:
^BScrawling of a Mad Man^R

Friends\xe2\x80\xa6I think this explosion may rock the region. Now how do I get this on TV?

Downtown Al Mazrah has a station. Perhaps I should give it a visit?

-Samum
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO03:
^BPrinted Out Office Memo^R

To the staff\xe2\x80\xa6

We received a disturbing phone call that the infamous "Samum" is on his way over to our station. I expect you will want to either leave early or lock yourself in after reading this memo. 

We expect to continue to report the news as long as we can. Extra security has been assigned to the lobby.

Please stay safe.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO04:
^BHastily Written Note^R

The news station was a waste of time. Make sure the ingredients are correct and they will have no choice to cover this story. 

Wait for my signal.

-Samum
MP_DMZ_NOTES/PYRO05:
^BHastily Written Note^R

If you are reading this, the deed is done. Tank #1 burns, but I don\xe2\x80\x99t think I\xe2\x80\x99m done yet. It\xe2\x80\x99s time to retreat into the tunnels where they won\xe2\x80\x99t find us. 

I forced a worker to reprogram the access code. The code is in my original notes\xe2\x80\xa6that I lost back on that ship. 

-Samum

MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF01:
^BResearcher's Memo^R

Item 23b was stolen from the archive sometime in the last few weeks. This was clearly an elaborate operation as various security system were disabled in order to pull off this heist. 

The only clue so far has been a brochure to a lighthouse that is NOT a part of anything here at El Bagra.

Please be on the look out for anything else that might help lead to the location of 23b.

-Antiquities Inventory Team
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF02:
^BHandwritten Ransom Note^R

I have your precious antiquity. Pay me what it\xe2\x80\x99s worth or it leaves the country. Meet me on the bridge. The captain will mediate our negotiation.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF03:
^BCaptain\xe2\x80\x99s Log \xe2\x80\x93 Recent Entry^R

The treasure is being stored below deck, but one of the workers stole the only key to the box and ran off. He was dressed in some sort of postal uniform. 

Now the ship is under attack, and I can only hope we can get to open water before they damage the hull. What a mess this treasure has brought upon us.
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF04:
^BHandwritten Note^R

I am being followed. The key here is for what you think it\xe2\x80\x99s for. I just hope the ship hasn\xe2\x80\x99t left yet. If I don\xe2\x80\x99t make it, good luck and be safe.

-J
MP_DMZ_NOTES/THIEF05:
^BLaminated Sheet of Paper^R

Item 23b \xe2\x80\x93 Golden Skull of El Bagra Minor

Thought to contain magical powers. This skull is made of gold and, while it looks like so many other Golden Skulls, there appears to be some glyphs along the outside that make it unique and especially valuable. The meaning of the glyphs is unknown and still being investigated.
