PERKS/AR_AKE: Full-auto energy rifle.  Deploys best-in-class stopping power at a low, dependable fire rate.
perks/ar_akilo105: The Kastov 545 uses intermediate caliber 5.45x39 rounds, allowing for less recoil while maintaining a higher rate of fire.
perks/ar_akilo47: This modern, hard-hitting rifle is the core of the AK Platform. Chambered with large caliber 7.62x39 rounds, a skilled operator will find success with controlled shots.
perks/ar_akilo74: The Kastov-74u is a rifle optimized for short to medium distances. With a shortened receiver and barrels designed for short-range combat, the Kastov-74u gains significant maneuverability at the expense of effective range.
PERKS/AR_AR57: Full-auto ballistic rifle.  Channels a fast fire rate through a ^5lightweight mold^7 for increased hip fire control and mobility.
PERKS/AR_ARCLASSIC: Full-auto ballistic rifle.  Celebrated for rapid, powerful fire and an ^5integrated grenade launcher^7.
perks/ar_augolf: The STB 556 is a closed-bolt rifle built around modularity and accuracy, ideal for mid to long-range fights.
PERKS/AR_FMG: Full-auto energy rifle.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to split the rifle into ^5akimbo auto-pistol mode^7 for close quarter combat.   Features the highest fire rate in class.
perks/ar_golf3: A delayed blowback 7.62 receiver with equal parts power and control. Select fire allows precise semi-auto shots and short bursts of devastating full-auto firepower.
perks/ar_kilo53: The Lachmann-556 is the keystone in the Lachmann Meer arsenal. An adaptive 5.56 weapon system that bridges the gap between submachine guns and full-powered rifles.
PERKS/AR_M4: Full-auto ballistic rifle.  A moderate fire rate yields increased stability for best-in-class accuracy.  Ideal for mid to long range engagement.
perks/ar_mcbravo: With an integrated suppressor and slow, high-energy subsonic .300 BLK rounds, the Chimera is adept at close-quarters combat. Subsonic Ammo hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
perks/ar_mcharlie: The M13B features a short-stroke piston system that allows for a high rate of fire and low recoil.
perks/ar_mike16: Tuned for mid to long-range engagements, the M16 features a 3-round burst rifle that has increased range and stability.
perks/ar_mike4: The flagship rifle of the M4 Platform. This reliable workhorse is a jack-of-all-trades that performs well in most combat scenarios.
perks/ar_scharlie: With a high fire rate and combat flexibility, the TAQ-56 is a full-auto rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm.
perks/ar_schotel: A moderate fire rate, heavy-hitting 7.26 rounds, and controllable recoil make the TAQ-V a solid contender for medium to long-range engagements.
PERKS/AR_SCSIERRA: Compact and maneuverable, the TAC-PRO brings hard-hitting 5.56 to close combat situations. Stopping power and versatility come standard with this Tactique Verte receiver.
PERKS/AR_SDFAR: 3-round burst energy rifle.  Each burst applies extreme stopping power at precise intervals.
perks/br_msecho: A high-powered ^2.458 Battle Rifle^7 that delivers severe damage at medium range.
perks/br_soscar14: Adapt to any situation with this select-fire rifle. Stay in semi-auto for long-distance target shooting or switch to full auto when things get up close and personal.
perks/desc_c4: High explosives that stick to surfaces and can be detonated remotely with [{+frag}] or by double-tapping [{+reload}].
perks/desc_frag_grenade: Hold to control fuse time, remember to release. Produces lethal radius damage upon detonation.
perks/desc_pulse_grenade: Sticky grenade that emits 3 medium damage AoE pulse waves.
perks/desc_semtex: Timed explosive device that starts its countdown on release. Sticks to any surface.
perks/desc_specialist: Earn extra perks through your streak.  The streak and rewards reset upon death.
perks/desc_throwing_knife: Retrievable knife that causes instant death on impact.
perks/desc_trophy: Deployable autonomous defense system that destroys up to three incoming projectiles.
perks/dm_la700: A bolt-action sniper rifle with a hammer-forged barrel and chambered in .300 magnum.
perks/dm_mike14: The semi-automatic EBR-14 is chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO and balances fire rate with long-range lethality.
perks/dm_mike24: The pillar of the Bryson bolt rifles, the SP-R 208 is a bolt-action rifle designed for precise shots at longer distances.
perks/dm_pgolf1: The LM-S is a highly accurized semi-automatic rifle available to military and police. Precision manufacturing provides unmatched accuracy for long-range engagements.
perks/dm_sa700: Optimized for speed and precision, the SA-B 50 bolt-action rifle features a pistol grip and lightweight frame for increased maneuverability.
perks/dm_sbeta: The Lockwood Mk2 is a high-power, lever-action rifle with old-west sentiments and modern-day aesthetics.
perks/dm_scromeo: The TAQ-M offers long-range support with a 6.5mm sniper round and modular design.
perks/dm_xmike2010: The SP-X 80 is a .300 magnum sniper rifle designed for long-range target acquisition and elimination.
perks/dmr_m1_classic: Semi-auto ballistic rifle.  An old, reliable service rifle with moderate stopping power and low recoil.  The ^5top-loading clip^7 must be exhausted to reload.
perks/flash_grenade_desc: Produces a blinding flash and deafening noise levels sufficient to daze and disorient anyone within effective radius.
perks/healing_syringe_desc: Injects hemostasis compound that heals wounds quickly.
perks/helmet_desc: Reinforced helmet with extra protection against headshots.
perks/knife_only_desc: A CQC tactical knife.  Standard military issue, employed for fast, quiet, and deadly wetwork.
perks/la_gromeo: Portable infrared surface-to-air missile with a free-fire option. Self-propelled missiles have a higher speed and moderate explosive yield.
perks/la_juliet: Attack vehicles where armor is weakest with the JOKR. This fire-and-forget launcher is portable and drops a high-explosive payload from above.
perks/la_kgolf: From a recoilless rifle, launch a high-velocity, low-damage ultra-precise missile that is devastating against vehicles.
perks/la_mike32: An infantry-carried, revolving grenade launcher that fires 40mm projectiles that explode on impact.
perks/la_rpapa7: An infantry-carried launcher that fires a rocket-propelled grenade for high damage. Unguided missile requires manual aiming.
perks/lm_ahotel: Used for squad support or solo hunting, the HCR 56 lays out full-auto fire from a controllable receiver.
perks/lm_foxtrot: The 556 Icarus is a lightweight squad-support weapon in the M4 Platform. Increased ammo capacity does not significantly impact mobility.
perks/lm_kilo21: Featuring a belt-fed 7.62mm receiver with all the modularity of the Lachmann Meer platform, the RAPP H offers versatility in the light machine gun class.
perks/lm_mkilo3: The Serval is a fully automatic, air-cooled light machine gun chambered in 5.56. Support your team and pin down the enemy with a high fire rate and overwhelming covering fire.
perks/lm_ngolf7: The belt-fed SAKIN MG38 light machine gun delivers devastating 7.62 rounds at a high fire rate thanks to a short-stroke gas piston.
perks/lm_rkilo: The RPK features a long, heavy barrel, high ammo capacity, and steel receiver capable of sustained full-auto fire without loss in accuracy.
perks/lm_slima: The Reconnaissance Auxiliary Assault Lightweight Machine Gun uses titanium construction, low fire rate and a reciprocating barrel to mitigate the powerful .338 recoil.
PERKS/LMG_LMG03: Full-auto energy weapon.  Delivers high damage with strong recoil.
PERKS/LMG_MAULER: Full-auto heavy ballistic weapon.  An experimental ^5gaussian delinker^7 channels ultra-rapid fire into a tight hip spread.
PERKS/LMG_SDFLMG: Full-auto energy weapon.  Offers a dependable fire rate and ^5high-capacity power cell^7 for sustained output.
perks/me_riotshield_desc: Ballistic-proof and explosive-resistant shield with increased melee damage.
perks/multivisor_desc: Gain multiple vision sets at once (^5Thermal^7, ^5SitRep^7, and ^5Phase-Vision^7).  Times out after ^510 seconds^7.
perks/pi_decho: A powerful semi-automatic pistol. Control the recoil and the .50 cal rounds will do the rest.
perks/pi_golf17: A light, semi-auto 9mm pistol with specialized and tactical modification options. The polymer frame keeps the weight down and the integrated rail allows laser attachments.
perks/pi_golf18: The highly specialized, fully automatic trigger assembly of the X13 delivers a staggering 20 rounds per second while sacrificing a great deal of accuracy and effective range.
perks/pi_papa220: For close-quarters situations, the Bruen .45 semi-auto pistol takes advantage of accuracy, reliability, and a hard-hitting .45 Auto round. Subsonic ammo hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
perks/pi_stimpistol: Equip a revive pistol capable of reviving downed teammates or yourself. Hits to critical locations may be harmful to hostile targets.
perks/pi_swhiskey: A double-action revolver firing .500 Cal rounds, the Centum 5 kicks hard but hits harder. Unstoppable in the right hands.
PERKS/PISTOL_EMC: Semi-auto energy pistol.  Reliably delivers consistent stopping power.
PERKS/PISTOL_G18: Semi-auto ballistic pistol.  Allows ultra-fast trigger cycling in a ^5lightweight mold^7 for increased hip fire control.
perks/pistol_g18_classic: Full-auto ballistic pistol.  Delivers the highest fire rate and recoil across all weapon classes.
PERKS/PISTOL_NRG: Full-auto energy pistol.  Features a ^5harmonic microcontroller^7 that accelerates fire rate over time.
perks/power_adrenaline_mist_desc: Device that emits adrenaline inducing mist, giving players higher pain tolerance while surrounded by it.
perks/power_ammo_box_desc: Deploy an ammo station for your allies.
perks/power_attack_drone_desc: Sends out an attack drone. Can manually be called back with [{+frag}]. Self destruct sequence can be initiated by double-tapping [{+reload}].
perks/power_barrier_desc: Fire this ability at teammates to provide them with light armor.  Land a precision shot on the head to give the ally additional protection from ^5headshots^7.
perks/power_biospike_desc: Thrown ballistic knife that explodes on enemy impact.  Can be recovered after use.
perks/power_blackoutgrenade_desc: Stuns enemies, causing vision and hearing loss.
perks/power_blinkknife_desc: Thrown high-tech knife that warps to enemy position on kill.  Can be recovered after use.
perks/power_bouncingbetty_desc: Deployable projectile that launches into the air before detonating.
perks/power_case_bomb_desc: Deploy a High Explosive Case bomb. Volitile bioplasma causes chain reactions
PERKS/POWER_CLUSTERGRENADE_DESC: Cookable grenade that explodes in a series of smaller blasts.
perks/power_comlink_desc: Battle positions updated in visor computer.
PERKS/POWER_CONCUSSION_GRENADE_DESC: Jams enemy minimap, movement, and aiming systems.  Effective against equipment.
perks/power_cone_flash_desc: Fires a blinding wave of force that increases your armor with each target hit.
perks/power_cryo_mine_desc: Magnetic mine that releases a supercoolant cloud, hindering movement systems.
perks/power_dash_desc: Use [{+breath_sprint}] to quickly move in the aimed direction. Forward dashes require the user to be in the air.
perks/power_disc_marker_desc: Throw down a marker for a Maverick VII missile strike.  (Best used outdoors)
perks/power_disruptor_desc: Thrown device that sights in on enemy optics and sends a focused shock at them.  Most effective if the enemy is currently in ADS.
perks/power_distortionfield_grenade_desc: This device deploys an aerial cloaking system that provides visual cover to those that are inside its sphere of influence.  Note that you are still vulnerable to all damage types, including ^5EMP^7 and ^5explosives^7, but you will be harder to pin down.
PERKS/POWER_EMP_GRENADE_DESC: Grenade that disables enemy suit abilities and damages equipment.
perks/power_eng_drone_desc: Deployable drone. Hold [{+smoke}] and press [{+activate}] to cycle between drone states: ^5Defense^7 or ^5Support^7.
perks/power_exploding_drone_desc: Launched aerial drone that explodes on impact or remotely with [{+frag}] or by double-tapping [{+reload}].
perks/power_fear_grenade_desc: Places a mine. Upon detonation, releases nanomachines that hack enemy Visors, causing them to see threats that are not real.
perks/power_forcepush_desc: Release a wave of concussive force that stuns and pushes enemies.
perks/power_hack_knife_desc: Nanomachines infiltrate enemy rigs, turning them to your side for a short time.
perks/power_mortarmount_desc: Fire a devastating mortar off your back. Use indoors at your own risk.
perks/power_opticwave_desc: Brief pulse that personally outlines enemies through walls.
perks/power_overcharge_desc: Increased damage for non explosive weapons.
perks/power_periphvis_desc: Activated sensor array that tracks enemy location by heat signature.
perks/power_phasesplit_desc: Suit bends light creating a hologram decoy of the player that runs out ahead.
perks/power_portal_generator_desc: Create a physical portal that allows anyone to enter phase shift for a short time.
perks/power_portal_grenade_desc: A grenade that applies an extreme reverse gravitational impulse against any enemy within the blast radius.
perks/power_proxybomb_desc: Bouncy grenade that detonates on contact with enemy targets.
PERKS/POWER_SENSORGRENADE_DESC: Bouncy grenade that outlines close enemies. Temporarily disorients and slows enemies on detonation.
perks/power_shard_ball_desc: Sticky grenade that launches itself in the air, scattering a series of explosive shards in all directions.
perks/power_siegemode_desc: Transorm into a stationary turret with strong frontal armor.
perks/power_siphonknife_desc: Siphon power from your enemies and use it to empower your defenses and health regeneration.
perks/power_smokegrenade_desc: Creates a smoke screen that blocks vision and automated targeting systems.
perks/power_sonicsensor_desc: Device that detects enemy sounds via sonic pulses, revealing enemy positions.  ^5Countered by^7 equipping sound nullifying perks (^5Dead Silence^7)
perks/power_speed_strip_desc: Passing through the ^5Velocity Ehancement Field^7 gives the player a temporary boost to speed and cooldown reduction.
perks/power_spider_grenade_desc: Autonomous sticky device that seeks out nearby enemies and explodes.
PERKS/POWER_SPLASH_GRENADE_DESC: Sticky grenade that sprays burning plasma in all directions.
perks/power_split_grenade_desc: Splits into multiple propelled grenades on impact.
perks/power_stealth_mode_desc: Gives all stealth perks for a set time and adds a silencer to your weapon.
perks/power_thermobaric_desc: Fuel-air grenade that creates a large but low damage blast radius and weakens armor.
perks/power_throwing_knife_smokewall_des: Thrown device that deploys a quickly forming ionic smoke wall.  Great for distraction.
perks/power_throwing_reaper_desc: Plasma spear damages and stuns struck enemies.
perks/power_transponder_desc: Thrown device that allows you to instantly teleport to the device's location when activated.
perks/power_trip_mine_desc: Magnetic mine that detonates when an enemy interrupts the beam.
perks/power_virus_grenade_desc: Infects enemy suits, temporarily blocks regenerative systems. The virus can spread to enemies near the virus host.
perks/power_wristrocket_desc: Rocket propelled system that delivers a timed, sticky plastique payload.
perks/sh_charlie725: This break-action shotgun sacrifices ammo capacity for extended range and a tight pellet spread.
perks/sh_mbravo: A reliable, highly customizable pump-action shotgun. Configurable for either close or medium range, the Bryson 800 is synonymous with versatility.
perks/sh_mike1014: A practiced hand can control the Expedite 12's recoil to devastating effect. This semi-auto shotgun features a regulated gas system, ergonomic stock, and standard rail.
perks/sh_mviktor: This mag-fed pump-action shotgun takes room clearing seriously. Detachable magazine speeds up reloads.
PERKS/SHOTGUN_DEVASTATOR: Semi-auto ballistic shotgun.  Features a ^5cyclic drum magazine^7 for quick trigger response.
PERKS/SHOTGUN_SDFSHOTTY: Full-auto energy shotgun.  Rapid fire capability is supported by a ^5high-capacity power cell^7.
PERKS/SHOTGUN_SONIC: Pump-action sonic shotgun.  Employs a high decibel ^5acoustic driver^7 yielding balanced stopping power and fire rate.
perks/shotgun_spas_classic: Pump-action ballistic shotgun.  An esteemed and rugged firearm that trades a slow rechamber rate for incredible range and stopping power.
perks/sm_alpha57: The FSS Hurricane sacrifices range and stopping power for increased ammo capacity and enhanced stability.
perks/sm_apapa: A submachine gun conversion of the rifle receiver, the MX9 submachine gun performs well at close to mid-range. Subsonic Ammo hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
PERKS/SM_AUGOLF: A modular, fully automatic weapon configured for mobility and close range combat.
perks/sm_aviktor: An enhanced and modern version of the AK Platform, the 9mm Zyklov 9 boasts an aggressively high rate of fire and leads the way in short to mid-range engagements.
perks/sm_beta: With a high rate of fire, straight blowback system, and a unique high-capacity magazine, the Minibak shreds in close-quarters combat.
perks/sm_mpapa5: The Lachmann Sub\xe2\x80\x99s compact, fully automatic 9mm receiver is a masterpiece of stability, mobility, and lethality. The modular system is configurable for a variety of covert and close-quarters operations.
perks/sm_mpapa7: Chambered in 4.6x30mm, the VEL 46 is a maneuverable submachine gun with moderate recoil.
perks/sm_mpapax: An aggressive fire rate and modular frame make the BAS-P perfect for the discerning operator who wants to customize their submachine gun. Subsonic ammo hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
perks/sm_papa90: Rapid-fire, a compact polymer frame, and high-velocity ammunition make the PDSW 528 a powerhouse for room clearing.
perks/sm_victor: With a blinding fire rate, the Fennec 45 excels at room clearing and holding down the front line. ^3Subsonic Ammo^7 hides kill skulls from the enemy team.
PERKS/SMG_CRB: Full-auto ballistic firearm.  Built-in ^5dual magazines^7 provide faster reloads and increased ammo capacity.
PERKS/SMG_ERAD_SHOTGUN: Full-auto energy firearm.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to switch to ^5Shotgun Mode^7.
PERKS/SMG_FHR: Full-auto ballistic firearm.  Offsets a modest range with an extreme fire rate thanks to a unique ^5magnetic bolt carrier^7.
PERKS/SMG_RIPPER: Full-auto ballistic firearm.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to toggle ^5assault rifle mode^7.  An integrated ^5hybrid sight^7 enhances longer range engagements.
perks/smg_ump45_classic: Full-auto ballistic firearm.  Popular with old Earth agencies for delivering high stopping power at range despite a low fire rate.
perks/sn_alpha50: Hard hitting, bolt action sniper rifle with .50 cal BMG ammunition.  Its tungsten sabot tipped bullets are fast and powerful, but require precise shots over long distances.
perks/sn_crossbow: Silent and agile, this high-performance crossbow fires 20.0" bolts with exceptional lethality.  Exclusive customization, distinct functionality, and unique ammunition types put this weapon in a class of its own.  Standard 20.0" bolts are recoverable, and are undetectable by trophy systems.
perks/sn_limax: Featuring a reciprocating barrel that mitigates the recoil of the devastating ^2.50 Cal^7 cartridge, this anti-materiel rifle is built for consistent shots on target to take out anything you aim at.
perks/sn_mromeo: The Multi-Caliber Precision Rifle is a cutting-edge sniper rifle, chambered for the powerful .300 magnum round. This modular bolt-action sniper rifle is ready to adapt to the ever-evolving needs of the operator.
perks/sniper_cheytac_classic: Bolt-action ballistic rifle.  Renowned for superior stability, handling, and unforgiving recoil.
PERKS/SNIPER_KBS: Bolt-action ballistic rifle.  One shot, one kill from the waist up.  Rechambering breaks scope aim.
PERKS/SNIPER_M8: Semi-auto energy rifle.  Hold ^5[{toggleweapalt,+weapnext}]^7 to activate ^5assault rifle mode^7 for automatic fire and reduced power consumption.
PERKS/SP_ATOMIZER_DESC: Experimental energy based handgun that blasts victims into a cloud of mist. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_BEAM_STEELDRAGON: Powerful energy beam with auto tracking. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_LAUNCHER_CHARGESHOT_DESC: Charge up plasma launcher with extreme splash damage. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_LAUNCHER_LOCKON_DESC: Anti-air launcher. Supports straight dumb fire and locking-on to air targets. (No ammo crate refills)
PERKS/SP_PENETRATOR_DESC: Highly accurate electromagnetic projectile launcher with increased penetration capability. (No ammo crate refills)
PLATFORM/SEASON_PASS_TITLE_LONG: Call of Duty\xc2\xae: Modern Warfare\xc2\xae II - Season Pass
platform/tu_required: An update is required. You must be signed in to Battle.net and accept the update to play Call of Duty\xc2\xae.
PLAYLIST/SURVIVAL_DESC: Assemble your team and defend yourselves against waves of increasingly difficult threats, earning the experience and equipment to outlast the enemy.
PMC/ACQUIRE_SPEND_CASH_ACQUIRE_DESC: Acquire $^.&&1^7 in cash in one match.
PMC/ACQUIRE_SPEND_CASH_DETAIL_DESC:
We have associates that can provide you goods in the field, but it'll cost you. I'm talking about hard earned cash. Find it in the field or sell some valuables. Get enough to make it worth your while and spend it at our friend's shops.

Acquire $^.&&1^7 in cash in one match.
Spend $^.&&2^7 at a Shop.
pmc/american_desc: The missions for this Faction are focused on eliminating other operators.
PMC/AMMO_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC:
Our next supply delivery was delayed and we're running low on ammunitions. Bring us enough to last.

Extract ^.&&1^7 Pistol/SMG ammo.
Extract ^.&&2^7 AR/LMG ammo.
Extract ^.&&3^7 800 Shotgun ammo.
PMC/AQ_NOTE_1_DESC: Black Mous seems to have taken an interest in our research. For some privacy I hide the drill elsewhere but ideally we need to dispose of it soon. I left a better description for its location in another hidden container. I got the new recruits to bury it off the coast near the Sawah Village. They probably got lazy and just threw it off the park's cliffs.
PMC/AQ_NOTE_2_DESC: To stay under the radar, the drill's not far from where we left the boat. I buried it in a container on the east side of the river close to that dock in Taraq. You'll find it under the electric pylon.
PMC/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a FTac Recon with a 4x optic attached at Sa'id.
Kill ^.&&2^7 operators with a FTac Recon with a thermal optic attached.
PMC/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_ENEMIES_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies with a FTac Recon with a 4x optic attached at Sa'id.
PMC/BATTLE_RIFLE_KILL_OPERATORS_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a FTac Recon with a thermal optic attached.
PMC/BLACK_MOUS_INTEL_DESC: Classified documents containing computer records and transactions between Rohan Oil and Black Mous.
pmc/british_desc: The missions for this Faction are focused on exploration and travel through the DMZ.
PMC/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_BUY_DESC: Buy a Precision Airstrike from a Shop.
PMC/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_DETAIL_DESC:
Some new jets came in and we're looking to test out their capabilities. Buy a Precision Airstrike from a Shop and use it on some hostiles. 

Buy a Precision Airstrike from a Shop.
Use Precision Airstrikes to kill ^.&&2^7 enemies.
PMC/BUY_KILL_PRECISION_KILL_DESC: Use Precision Airstrikes to kill ^.&&1^7 enemies.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Park a vehicle at all ^.&&1^7 gas stations in Zarqwa Hydroelectric.
Plant a charge at each gas station in Zarqwa Hydroelectric with a parked vehicle.
When all charges are set, climb to the second level of the radio tower in Zarqwa Hydroelectric and detonate the charges.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_EXPLODE_DESC: When all charges are set, climb to the second level of the radio tower in Zarqwa Hydroelectric and detonate the charges.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_PARK_DESC: Park a vehicle at all ^.&&1^7 gas stations in Zarqwa Hydroelectric.
PMC/CAR_BOMB_STORY_PLANT_DESC: Plant a charge at each gas station in Zarqwa Hydroelectric with a parked vehicle.
PMC/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_DETAIL_DESC:
There's word of some goods being transported through the AO and some of our contractors will pay a hefty price for them. AQ is loading the cargo on some vehicles. You'll need to secure the vehicle and move to a designated HLZ where Slasher-2 will meet you to extract the package. Those transport vehicles are worth something on their own as well, so don't let them go to waste. Repair and refuel the vehicle afterwards. 

Complate a Cargo Delivery contract.
Fully repair and refuel the transport vehicle.
PMC/CARGO_FUEL_REPAIR_FUEL_REPAIR_DESC: Fully repair and refuel the transport vehicle.
PMC/CAVES_INTEL_DESC: Records of incoming and outgoing shipments of chemicals, oil, opioids, narcotics, and weapons.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_DETAIL_DESC:
That intel you brought back revealed some details of how Al-Qatala is smuggling contraband through the AO. We need to figure out the routes their transports are taking out of Al-Mazrah. There's some trucks in the cave complex marked by AQ. Put Tracking Devices on them. We left them for you in the junkyard dead drop near Al-Sharim Pass. Also there's a server room in a bunker at the caves. Go there and hook us into it.

Loot ^.&&1^7 Tracking Devices from the Al-Sharim Pass dumpster dead drop.
Plant ^.&&2^7 Tracking Devices on the AQ trucks in Sattiq Cave Complex in one match.
Travel to the server rack in the bunker at Sattiq Cave Complex and download the data.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_DOWNLOAD_DESC: Travel to the server rack in the bunker at Sattiq Cave Complex and download the data.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 Tracking Devices from the Al-Sharim Pass dumpster dead drop.
PMC/CAVES_TRACKING_PLANT_DESC: Plant ^.&&1^7 Tracking Devices on the AQ trucks in Sattiq Cave Complex in one match.
PMC/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DESC: Clear a Stronghold of enemy combatants.
PMC/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_DETAIL_DESC:
Another faction, the White Lotus, used to hold critical positons at nearby strongholds, that is until Al-Qatala took over Al-Mazrah. We need some intel on the White Lotus that informants claim is held within the strongholds. Local AQ combatants should have keys to them.

Acquire a Stronghold key.
Clear a Stronghold of enemy combatants.
Extract the White Lotus intel found on Stronghold guards.
PMC/CLEAR_STRONGHOLD_INTEL_DESC: Extract the White Lotus intel found on Stronghold guards.
PMC/COMPLETE_HUNT_EXTRACT_WEAPON_DETAIL_:
We're conducting some recon on the equipment of our competitors. Take a contract to hunt enemy operators. Bring their weapon back to us for inspection.

Complete ^.&&1^7 Hunt contract.
Extract an enemy operator's weapon.
PMC/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_CONSOLE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Game Consoles to the dumpster dead drop north of Cemetery.
PMC/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB. We need some computer parts sent to one of our hideouts. Ideally they're in good condition so we can take them apart. The bigger pieces can be delivered to one of our dumpster dead drops. It's north of the cemetery, in a small village built next to the railroad.

Deliver ^.&&1^7 GPUs to the dumpster dead drop north of Cemetery.
Deliver ^.&&2^7 Game Consoles to the dumpster dead drop north of Cemetery.
Extract ^.&&3^7 Hard Drives.
PMC/COMPUTER_DELIVERY_GPU_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 GPUs to the dumpster dead drop north of Cemetery.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_DESC: Documents detailing the various operations, incoming and outgoing shipments, employees, customers, and government contracts.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Acquire a key for the Crane Building Base in Al-Safwa Quarry.
Unlock the Crane Building Base.
Extract the Quarry Operations Folder in the Crane Building Base.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_EXTRACT_DESC: Extract the Quarry Operations Folder in the Crane Building Base.
PMC/CRANE_INTEL_EXTRACT_KEY_DESC: Acquire a key for the Crane Building Base in Al-Safwa Quarry.
PMC/DELIVER_EQUIPMENT_MODERNCITY_DELIVER: Deliver ^.&&1^7 pieces of lethal equipment to the dumpster dead drop at Modern City.
PMC/DELIVER_EQUIPMENT_MODERNCITY_DETAIL_:
We're running into a shortage of lethal equipment. There's a dumpster in an alley in Modern City. We're paying some guys to discretely bring back equipment we drop in there. Find the dumpster dead drop and deliver some lethal equipment to it.

Travel to Modern City.
Deliver ^.&&2^7 pieces of lethal equipment to the dumpster dead drop at Modern City.
PMC/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_DETAIL_DES:
One of our FOBs was assaulted by AQ and we're like to destroy any evidence they might collect from there. We're out of ammunition for our mortars there, but one of our explosive technicians here has a shopping list of items he'd like. We setup a dead drop near the railroad west of Rohan Oil for some gas. The other items need to be extracted.

Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gas Cans to a dumpster dead drop in between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
Extract ^.&&2^7 Molotovs or Thermite Grenades.
Extract ^.&&3^7 Lighters, Comic Books, Bandages, or Folders.
PMC/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_GASCANS_DE: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gas Cans to a dumpster dead drop in between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
PMC/DELIVER_EXTRACT_FLAMABLES_ITEMS_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 Lighters, Comic Books, Bandages, or Folders.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Deliver ^.&&1^7 tubes of Toothpastes to the dumpster dead drop at Mawizeh Marsh.
Deliver ^.&&2^7 rolls of Electrical Tape to the dumpster dead drop at Modern City.
Deliver ^.&&3^7 Canned Foods to the dumpster dead drop at Modern City.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_FOOD_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Canned Foods to the dumpster dead drop at Modern City.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_TAPE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 rolls of Electrical Tape to the dumpster dead drop at Modern City.
PMC/DELIVER_SUPPLIES_TOOTHPASTE_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 tubes of Toothpastes to the dumpster dead drop at Mawizeh Marsh.
PMC/DEMOLITION_SAFE_DETAIL_DESC:
One of our contracts has intel on AQ safes in the area. They're willing to give up that intel in exchange for a small job. They need you to destroy supply sites. Infil and find an AQ burner phone with intel on the supply site locations.

Acquire a Destroy Supplies contract.
Complete a Destroy Supplies contract.
Open a Safe.
PMC/DOG_TAG_EXTRACT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Extract ^.&&1^7 enemy Dog Tags.
Kill ^.&&2^7 operators with a suppressed assault rifle.
PMC/DOG_TAG_EXTRACT_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 operators with a suppressed assault rifle.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_BUY_DESC: Purchase a Tactical Vehicle with a turret at a Shop.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_DESTROY_DESC: Destroy the Tactical Vehicle in Mawizeh Marsh.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_DETAIL_DESC:
You've probably heard of the White Lotus faction by now. AQ seems to treat them as only a minor threat. We need you to change that. Get a car, ideally one with a big gun with some decent armor. Mow down some forces in Ahkdar, at least enough to cause some panic. Drive it to the marshlands and destroy the evidence. My team will release some false intel linking the attack to White Lotus.

Purchase a Tactical Vehicle with a turret at a Shop.
Use the Tactical Vehicle turret to kill ^.&&2^7 enemies in Ahkdar.
Destroy the Tactical Vehicle in Mawizeh Marsh.
PMC/DRIVE_BY_STORY_KILL_DESC: Use the Tactical Vehicle turret to kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in Ahkdar.
PMC/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB. There's Las Almas members visiting Al-Mazrah. Intel shows they're taking part in weapon and drug trafficking. Investigate their involvement with Al-Qatala.

Complete an Eliminate HVT contract.
Collect a dropped key from the HVT.
Use a key to unlock a locked space.
PMC/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_LOOT_DESC: Collect a dropped key from the HVT.
PMC/ELIM_LOOT_UNLOCK_UNLOCK_DESC: Use a key to unlock a locked space.
PMC/ELIM_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete an Eliminate HVT contract in under ^.3^7 minutes.
PMC/ELIM_SPEEDRUN_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Complete an Eliminate HVT contract in under ^.3^7 minutes.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_DELIVER_DESC: Deliver the laptop to the dumpster dead drop north-east of the Cemetery.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_DETAIL_DESC:
We've been tracking a high profile political figure whose been spotted multiple times in the north-west of Al-Mazrah. His temporary residence is in the poppy fields north of the Sattiq Cave Complex. You'll need a key to enter. Try to make your way into the compound and steal his laptop. Take it to the dumpster dead drop north-east of the Cemetery where we left a USB device that will give us access to the laptop. Placed the hacked laptop back where you found it. 

Enter the Poppy Fields Home and loot the target's laptop.
Deliver the laptop to the dumpster dead drop north-east of the Cemetery.
Plant the hacked laptop back in the Poppy Fields Home where it was taken from.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Enter the Poppy Fields Home and loot the target's laptop.
PMC/ESPIONAGE_STORY_PLANT: Plant the hacked laptop back in the Poppy Fields Home where it was taken from.
PMC/EXECUTE_KILL_STUNNED_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Kill ^.&&1^7 stunned Stronghold guards
Execute ^.&&2^7 enemies wielding riot shields.
PMC/EXFIL_ITEM_DESC: Exfil with an item in your backpack.
PMC/EXTRACT_MEDS_DETAIL_DESC:
A few of our operators have sustained injuries from a recent AQ assault. They're fine but our medical supplies in the FOB are running low and we can't risk a transport vehicle getting hit on the road. We need you to go in and secure some light medical supplies.

Loot a medicine cabinet.
Extract ^.&&2^7 Medical Syringes.
Extract ^.&&3^7 Bandages.
PMC/EXTRACT_PHOTOS_DETAIL_DESC:
There's some evidence of Al-Qatala's involvement in the Piccadilly attack found within the AO. Bring it back to us. Also bring back any intel you can find on our faction. We have some competitors and we'd rather not let them get their hands on our documents.

Extract ^.&&1^7 Al-Qatala Planning Diagrams
Extract ^.&&2^7 Al-Qatala Planning Photos
Extract ^.&&3^7 pieces of Black Mous Intel.
PMC/EXTRACT_PHOTOS_INTEL_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 pieces of Black Mous Intel.
PMC/EXTRACT_TACTICALS_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB. We have a shortage of equipment as you may know and it's harder for our paid locals to smuggle higher-tech tactical equipment out of the AO. Bring back some specific tactical equipment yourself. Gas grenades, flashes, and snapshots. Their future use is on a need to know basis.

Extract ^.&&1^7 Gas Grenades
Extract ^.&&2^7 Flash Grenades.
Extract ^.&&3^7 Snapshot Grenades.
PMC/EXTRACT_WEAPONS_CASE_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Complete ^.&&1^7 Secure Intel contracts.
Kill ^.&&2^7 Commanders.
Extract ^.&&3^7 Weapons Case.
PMC/EXTRACT_WEAPONS_CASE_STREAK_DETAIL_D:
STUB.

Extract ^.&&1^7 Weapon Cases without dying.
PMC/FACTION_INTEL_DESC: Documents containing information on active and inactive members of the White Lotus faction.
PMC/FINAL_EXFIL_CASH_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Acquire a Durable Gas Mask.
Exfil ^.&&2^7 times with the final exfil with ^.60k^7 cash.
PMC/FINAL_EXFIL_CASH_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil ^.&&1^7 times with the final exfil with ^.60k^7 cash.
PMC/FORT_LOOT_KILL_DETAIL_DESC:
Al-Qatala has taken an interest in the southern coastal fortress. Our intel just shows it as a historic site. We need some operators to scout it out.

Travel to El Bagra Fortress.
Loot ^.&&2^7 caches in El Bagra Fortress.
Kill ^.&&3^7 enemies in El Bagra Fortress.
PMC/FORT_LOOT_KILL_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies in El Bagra Fortress.
PMC/FORT_LOOT_KILL_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 caches in El Bagra Fortress.
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_DETAIL_DESC:
We're looking for some documentation regarding Al-Qatala computer systems for a future operation. We tracked it to the sewers underneath the southern coastal fortress. There's a security system at play there. Once you enter the sewers you'll only have a few minute to disable the security system. There's seven electrical breakers throughout the sewer that you need to reroute before the security system triggers and reinforcements are called in. After you deal with the security system, extract the System Architecture. Watch out for the Armored Commander on patrol in that compound as well.

Travel to the sewer under El Bagra Fortress.
Reroute the ^.&&2^7 security devices in under ^.4:00^7 minutes to unlocked the System Architecture's container
Loot and extract the System Architecture Documentation
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_DISARM_DESC: Reroute the ^.&&1^7 security devices in under ^.4:00^7 minutes to unlocked the System Architecture's container
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract the System Architecture Documentation
PMC/FORT_SEWER_STORY_TRAVEL_DESC: Travel to the sewer under El Bagra Fortress.
PMC/FUEL_REPAIR_DESC: Fuel and repair vehicles at ^.&&1^7 gas stations.
PMC/FUEL_REPAIR_LOOT_GAS_CANS_DETAIL_DES:
A future operation requires that you have some experience with fueling and repairing vehicles at gas stations. You should also have some practice fueling your vehicle en-route with gas cans. They can be found at gas stations.

Fuel and repair vehicles at ^.&&1^7 gas stations.
Loot ^.&&2^7 Gas Cans.
PMC/FULL_BACKPACK_LOADOUT_DESC: Exfil with a full backpack and a full loadout ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC/FULL_BACKPACK_LOADOUT_DETAIL_DESC:
Costs to operate our exfiltration helos has been increasing and we're asking operators to make the most out of each infiltration. Come back with a full backpack and loadout including lethals, tacticals, a field upgrade, a killstreak, a self-revive kit, a gas mask, and a full set of armor plates. 

Exfil with a full backpack and a full loadout ^.&&1^7 times.
PMC/GEIGER_LOOT_DETAIL_DESC:
Hopefully you've seen the news about the attack on the nuclear plant. Word is that AQ was responsible. Multiple local informants claim they're hiding the evidence in buried barrels in the AO. Our friend has a contract out to gather that evidence. Take the contract and they'll lead you to some Geiger counters that you can use to find the barrels.

Complete ^.&&1^7 Secure Radioactive Material contract.
Loot ^.&&2^7 items from the radioactive caches.
PMC/GEIGER_LOOT_LOOT_DESC: Loot ^.&&1^7 items from the radioactive caches.
pmc/german_desc: The missions for this Faction are focused on completing activities and eliminating enemy AI.
PMC/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Unlock Room 2 in the top floor of the hotel in Sawah Village.
Loot and extract the golden .50 GS from Room 2 in the hotel.
PMC/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_EXTRACT_DESC: Loot and extract the golden .50 GS from Room 2 in the hotel.
PMC/GOLD_DECHO_EXTRACT_UNLOCK_DESC: Unlock Room 2 in the top floor of the hotel in Sawah Village.

PMC/GOLD_DELIVERY_SKULL_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Gold Skulls to the dumpster dead drop south-east of Al-Sharim Pass.

Travel to every POI while carrying the GPS Tracker in one deployment.
Extract the GPS Tracker
PMC/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_LOOT_DESC: Loot a GPS Tracker from the dumpster dead drop in Sa'id.
PMC/GPS_TRAVEL_STORY_TRAVEL_DESC: Travel to every POI while carrying the GPS Tracker in one deployment.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Deliver ^.&&1^7 Proximity Mines or Claymores to the dumpster dead drop in between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
Deliver ^.&&2^7 Thermite Grenades to the dumpster dead drop in Modern City in one deployment.
Extract ^.&&3^7 Frag Grenades in one deployment.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_FRAG_DESC: Extract ^.&&1^7 Frag Grenades in one deployment.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_MINES_DESC: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Proximity Mines or Claymores to the dumpster dead drop in between Al Safwa Quarry and Rohan Oil.
PMC/GRENADE_DELIVER_EXTRACT_THERMITE_DES: Deliver ^.&&1^7 Thermite Grenades to the dumpster dead drop in Modern City in one deployment.
PMC/HACK_KILL_UAV_DETAIL_DESC:
We're looking for better data on the geography of Al-Mazrah for future operations. Activate some UAV Towers so we can conduct some topographical surveys with the UAV. Try to keep a low profile and take out any nearby hostiles that might interfere. 

Activate ^.&&1^7 UAV Towers.
Kill ^.&&2^7 enemies pinged by UAV Towers.
PMC/HACK_KILL_UAV_KILL_DESC: Kill ^.&&1^7 enemies pinged by UAV Towers.

PMC/HACKED_USB_DESC: A thumb drive installed with malware and data logging software.

PMC/HERO_STRONGHOLD_CLEARS_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

In one deployment, unlock and clear: The Smuggler's Warehouse, the Post Office, and the Embassy.
PMC/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_DETAIL_DESC:
Al-Qatala has been taking potential informants in as hostages. Our associates would like you to protect them and will pay a hefty price if you can extract them safely. Find and secure the hostage, bring them to an HLZ and extract with the hostage to ensure their survival.

Complete a Rescue Hostage contract.
Exfil with the hostage evac helo.
PMC/HOSTAGE_EXFIL_EXFIL_DESC: Exfil with the hostage evac helo.
PMC/HOSTAGE_SPEEDRUN_DESC: Complete a Rescue Hostage contract in under ^.1:00^7 minute.

STUB.

Deliver ^.&&1^7 Bandages to the dumpster dead drop in Sa'id.
Extract ^.&&2^7 Self Revives.
Extract ^.&&3^7 bottles of Aspirin.

PMC/HUNT_STREAK_DETAIL_DESC:
STUB.

Complete ^.&&1^7 Hunt PMC Unit contracts without dying.
PMC/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_DETAIL_DESC:
You're one of few who we think is up for these kinds of confidential tasks. You're probably familiar with the water treatment facilities on the river. There's some wells that lead into the internal treatment and directly back into the river. Throw some Gas Grenades down into those wells. Distribute the gas evenly among the wells. Helps the chemical compounds to better dissolve.

Acquire ^.&&1^7 Gas Grenades.
Throw ^.&&2^7 Gas Grenades into the open water wells in Zarqwa Hydroelectric in one match.
PMC/HYDRO_GAS_STORY_THROW_DESC: Throw ^.&&1^7 Gas Grenades into the open water wells in Zarqwa Hydroelectric in one match.

STUB.

vehicles/apc_desc: This amphibious APC can lay down 30mm cannon fire, transport up to 6 squad members to the front line, and serves as a mobile spawn point.
vehicles/atv_desc: Take charge with rough and ready capability delivered with plenty of low-rpm torque and power. Top-tier rack capacity offers an impressive payload capability: hold 'er wide and send it.
vehicles/cargo_truck_desc: A large industrial vehicle. Slow moving, but may provide a small amount of protection in firefights.
vehicles/jeep_desc: Built and designed without compromise, a spacious interior allows for crew transportation to even the most remote corners of the map. Confident on- or off-road, with the durability to tackle the most extreme of challenges, the SUV can take a beating and keep on ticking.
vehicles/light_tank_desc: A maneuverable tank with a multipurpose turret and light armor.
vehicles/little_bird_desc: A twin-engine light helicopter for combat support and rapid traversal of the engagement zone.
vehicles/tac_rover_desc: The pinnacle of ultra-light tactical off-road vehicles, allowing rapid personnel deployment for squads of up to four. Go deep and hard in the most rugged and austere environments with world-class mobility and versatility.
vehicles/vehicle_horn_mountainking: In the Hall of the Mountain King
vehicles/vehicle_horn_toccata: Toccata and Fugue in D minor

WEAPON/REPEATER_DESC: Modified R.A.W. with an increased ammo capacity. Headshot kills will refill the clip.
